inferred: comparing the proteome of healthy control and oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) patients with and without lymph node metastasis.
The peptide mixtures were loaded onto stage-tip C18 for sample desalting and eluted with 80% acetonitrile in 0.1% formic acid.

This study comprised two patient cohorts: the first encompassed a pool of saliva samples from five patients with lymph node metastasis (pN+; “p” indicates the presence of metastasis in the lymph node histologically confirmed) and without lymph node metastasis (pN0) for protocol optimization, and an independent patient cohort including healthy control (n = 4) and OSCC patients (n = 8, pN0 = 4, pN+ = 4).
